Aggressive.description: As a bonus action, the [NAME] can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

Ambusher.description: The [NAME] has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

Avoidance.description: If the [NAME] is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to only take half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

Blood Frenzy.description: The [NAME] has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

Brute.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the [NAME] hits with it (included in the attack).

Damage Transfer.description: While attached or grappling a creature, the [NAME] takes only half damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the other creature takes the other half.

Death Burst.description: When the [NAME] dies, each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC [DC] Dexterity saving throw, taking [DIE AMOUNT] fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

Frightful Presence.description: Each creature of the [NAME]'s choice that is within 120 feet of the [NAME] and aware of it must succeed on a DC [DC] Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [NAME]'s [TRAIT NAME] for the next 24 hours.

Legendary Resistance (3/Day).description: If the [NAME] fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance.description: The [NAME] has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Martial Advantage.description: Once per turn, the [NAME] can deal an extra [DIE AMOUNT] damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the [NAME] that isn't incapacitated.

Nimble Escape.description: The [NAME] can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

Pack Tactics.description: The [NAME] has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the creature's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Parry.description: The creature adds its proficiency bonus to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it as a reaction.

Psychic Defense.description: While the [NAME] is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

Rampage.description: When the [NAME] reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the [NAME] can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

Regeneration.description: The [NAME] regains [AMOUNT] hit points at the start of its turn. If the [NAME] takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the [NAME]'s next turn. The [NAME] dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Shadow Stealth.description: While in dim light or darkness, the [NAME] can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

Relentless.description: If the [NAME] takes [AMOUNT] damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

Stench.description: Any creature other than a [NAME] that starts its turn within 5 feet of the [NAME] must succeed on a DC [DC] Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all [NAME]s for 1 hour.

Superior Invisibility.description: As a bonus action, the [NAME] magically turns invisible until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the [NAME] wears or carries is invisible with it.

Surprise Attack.description: If the [NAME] surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra [DIE AMOUNT] damage from the attack.

Wounded Fury.description: While it has [AMOUNT] hit points or fewer, the [NAME] has advantage on attack rolls. In addition, it deals an extra [DIE AMOUNT] damage to any target it hits with a melee attack.
